Frank Borman.title: Astronaut, Gemini 7 Commander
Frank Borman.role: On 5 December 1965 Borman radioed Houston during Gemini 7 reporting an unidentified object he called a 'bogey at 10 o'clock high.' The exchange is preserved in NASA-UAP-D3A.

Jim Lovell.title: Astronaut, Gemini 7 Pilot
Jim Lovell.role: Co-pilot on Gemini 7. After Borman's report Lovell concluded the bogey was likely the spent Titan II booster stage trailing in their orbit, but the audio was released as an unresolved UAP communication.

Apollo 11 Crew.title: Armstrong / Aldrin / Collins
Apollo 11 Crew.role: During the technical crew debriefing (NASA-UAP-D4, 1969) the Apollo 11 crew described an unidentified object visible after trans-lunar injection, eventually attributed by NASA to a panel from the SLA but logged as unresolved at the time.

Apollo 12 Crew.title: Conrad / Gordon / Bean
Apollo 12 Crew.role: Apollo 12's transcript (NASA-UAP-D1, 1969) and onboard photography captured several unexplained luminous objects, six of which were released as the NASA-UAP-VM photo series.

Apollo 17 Crew.title: Cernan / Evans / Schmitt
Apollo 17 Crew.role: The Apollo 17 transcript (NASA-UAP-D2, 1972) and crew debriefings reference luminous flashes and an unidentified object during the lunar phase. Capt. Eugene Cernan was the last man to walk on the Moon.

Skylab Crew.title: Skylab Mission Crew
Skylab Crew.role: The Skylab technical crew debriefing (NASA-UAP-D7, 1973) records visual sightings of an unknown rotating object during station-keeping.

U.S. Air Force.title: United States Air Force
U.S. Air Force.role: Lead service for early UFO investigations (Project SIGN, GRUDGE, BLUE BOOK). Author of the bulk of Cold War-era incident summaries (Box 7) and many Department of War mission reports in this release.

U.S. Navy.title: United States Navy
U.S. Navy.role: Source of multiple Range Fouler debriefs and shipborne sensor data, including PR36 (Middle East 2020) and the Iran-area encounters of August 2020.

U.S. Army.title: United States Army
U.S. Army.role: Reporting party for DOW-UAP-PR49 (North America, 2026). Historic ties via the Office of the Chief of Staff intelligence files (341_*).

INDOPACOM Operators.title: U.S. Indo-Pacific Command
INDOPACOM Operators.role: Reporting unit for sightings off Japan (PR47), East China Sea (PR46) and the Indo-PACOM AOR (PR48).

CENTCOM Operators.title: U.S. Central Command
CENTCOM Operators.role: Reporting unit for the bulk of recent unresolved UAP reports: Middle East 2020-2024, Iraq, Syria, the Arabian Gulf, and Greece.

FBI Field Agents.title: Federal Bureau of Investigation
FBI Field Agents.role: Authors of the 62-HQ-83894 case file and serial reports — investigative records, eyewitness testimonies, and public reports concerning Unidentified Flying Objects and flying discs documented between June 1947 and July 1968.

Department of State Officers.title: U.S. Department of State
Department of State Officers.role: Authors of cables documenting overseas UAP reports — Papua New Guinea (Jan 1985), Kazakhstan (Jan 1994), Mexico, Iran and others.
